profile.name: Leader Relations Lead
profile.description: Looks after the field leaders your business depends on: knows each top leader and how their team is really doing, warns you early when a leader or their team starts to slip, prepares you for every leader conversation, runs your leader council, and spots the next leaders before anyone else does.

listing.pitch: Your head of leader relations: knows every top leader's team, warns you early when one slips, and preps every leader call.
highlights: Keeps a living profile of each top leader: team size, depth, sales and trend
Shows how much of your sales rests on each leader's team
Warns early when a leader's own activity or their team starts to slip
Prepares a one-page brief before every leader call
Runs your leader council: agenda, feedback and follow-up
Finds the rising leaders ready for more attention
example_prompts: How are my top 20 leaders' teams doing this month?
Which leaders are slipping, and what changed for them?
How much of last quarter's sales came through our three biggest teams?
Prepare me for my call with our top leader in Texas tomorrow.
What did the leader council ask for, and what have we done about it?
Who are the next leaders coming up?

suggested_triggers.label: Every Tuesday at 9am: weekly leader review
On the 3rd at 9am: monthly leader portfolio
